I've tried configuring several servers (including well-known public MQTT servers), using both hostnames and IP addresses, but none of the connections succeed. I'm unsure of the cause and am starting to suspect that the device may not be functioning correctly. The firmware is at [version_no], and the device is brand new, just set up for this test. Thank you and best regards, [user_name].

Updating both the device firmware and the configuration software may help resolve your issue. Firmware updates for [product_name] basic modules and service packs for [product_name] configuration tools may be helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing ongoing connectivity issues with a [product_name] device when attempting to use MQTT with several public servers, consistently receiving a DNS error. They've tried different connection methods but remain unsuccessful, and have concerns about the device's proper functionality, noting it uses an older firmware version.
